The issuer operates with a very high leverage ratio (Total Liabilities / Total Assets of ~81.4%) and exhibits weak liquidity with a current ratio below 1.0 (0.89x) and working capital deficit. While the company maintains a large asset base ($17B) and remains profitable with a 5.4% EBIT margin, its high financial risk and thin equity cushion ($3.17B) constrain its credit profile to the speculative grade.

DECISION: BB
